column1: # D98: independent IEEE 754 binary64 bit-pattern oracle for FloatAP::get_d.
# All expected outputs are EXACT unsigned integer bit-patterns, NOT real-valued doubles.
# A source Rational is independently rounded to p-bit binary nearest/even BEFORE
# IEEE 754 binary64 conversion, including p=53 input ties and inexact rationals.
# Normal 53-bit mantissa, subnormal 2^-1074 grid, zero and overflow handled by
# exact integer quotient/remainder and midpoint-even tests in N/D/U/Z modes.
# Sign bit is retained for zeros; infinities and maximum finite values encoded
# as unsigned 64-bit integers, avoiding any host floating point dependencies.
# No independent exact arithmetic, GMP, independent exact arithmetic, FloatAP or host double used as a reference.
